title: Porter Granger, the gentleman who tried to polish Bessie
summary: Granger worked with Hunter, wrote "Michigan Water Tastes Like Sherry Wine", wrote whole shows and never got credit.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But it was strange, because Porter Granger was a very elegant --
He was very -- always with his walking cane.
Now he was with Bessie. That must have been a strange combination.

He worked with me. But he always tried to get Bessie to be a lady. Always. He always used to try to talk to Bessie. He'd take and tell Bessie, Bessie, don't be rough, don't be loud. Because he was such a gentleman. And he never got recognition for the things he did. Now, Porter Granger wrote, 'Michigan Water Tastes Like Sherry Wine.' I recorded that for him. Have you got that?
I have several recordings of that.
Good. Well, I made that with him. And so many things that he didn't get credit for.
He wrote whole shows, didn't he?
Did he eventually become mentally ill?
Well, I think so. But you see, I stayed in Europe most of the time.
Uh-huh. But I don't think he was given the credit that he was due.
